name: Murcia (Spain, city)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Murcia (six crowns on red within a bordure of castles and lions, with hearts).
history: The flag of the municipality is entirely red, with the arms of the city at its centre. In 1361 Peter I granted Murcia the sixth crown to figure on the seal and the municipal banner, adding a bordure with the symbols of the Crown of Castile in gratitude for the Murcian role in the War of the Two Peters.
